answer: A bond is refunded only after 10 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The vertex counter is kept in quill and echo shows each reset. An copycat hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 10 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 628 identities would post 2339 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
